title: Dissipative solutions for viscoelastic phase separation with degenerate mobility: a dynamic transport approach
summary: We study the convergence of minimising movement approximations to weak solutions of a fourth-order viscoelastic phase separation system with degenerate concave mobility. The underlying semi-implicit variational scheme combines a dynamic transport distance for the phase-field variable with a weighted $L^2$-distance for a transformed stress variable. We establish subsequential convergence of the scheme and show that the limiting solutions satisfy the energy-dissipation inequality. To this end, we derive a coercivity estimate for the metric slope, which yields the required space-time regularity…
